build_binarizer_encoder: build a MultiProcFairSeqBinarizerEncoder to binarize text lines into Fairseq indexed datasets using a vocabulary file
process_lines_binarize: process lines with the binarizer encoder to convert text into Fairseq binary format with optional SentencePiece tokenization
merge_binarized_splits: merge multiple binarized dataset splits into a single Fairseq indexed dataset file using merge_results
tokenize_with_sentencepiece: tokenize text lines using SentencePiece or Fairseq tokenizer via the _tokenize method of the encoder
extract_shard_string: extract the shard identifier string from a filename using the _extract_shard_str static method
